title: AI Consultant - Products
description:
**Req ID:** 390389
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Consultant - Products to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
AI Consultant
  
  
NTT DATA is a trusted global innovator of business and technology services, helping clients innovate, optimize, and transform for success. We strive to hire exceptional, innovative, and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
**Overview:**  
The AI Consultant is a client-facing advisor within the AI Go-to-Market organization responsible for identifying, shaping, and mobilizing AI transformation opportunities. This role combines strategy acumen, AI fluency, structured consulting methods, and commercial orientation to help clients define AI value cases, operating models, roadmaps, and adoption approaches. The AI Consultant partners with AI Architects, Forward-Deployed Engineering, Delivery, Sellers, ecosystem partners, and Geo and Industry leaders to convert client priorities into qualified opportunities and successful engagements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Act as a trusted client advisor to identify AI transformation opportunities, business pain points, and value cases.
* Shape AI strategy, target operating model, governance, adoption, responsible AI, and transformation roadmaps for clients.
* Translate client needs into practical AI solutions in partnership with architects, FDE, delivery, and partner teams.
* Develop proposals, business cases, ROI models, proof-of-concept plans, and executive-ready client materials.
* Support opportunity qualification, deal shaping, solutioning, mobilization, and transition into delivery.
* Lead and support structured consulting activities, including workshops, stakeholder interviews, assessments, prioritization exercises, and roadmap development.
* Bring a strategic lens to client conversations, connecting AI use cases to operating model change, business outcomes, adoption, and measurable enterprise value.
* Reuse and improve global GTM assets, offering content, credentials, delivery patterns, and client-facing narratives.
* Stay current on AI, agentic AI, enterprise adoption trends, responsible AI, and partner capabilities to strengthen client advisory quality.

**Success Measures:**  

* Personal sales contribution or qualified pipeline contribution, as applicable by career level.
* Utilization or billability against target.
* Quality of client deliverables, proposal contribution, stakeholder feedback, and reuse of global GTM assets.
* Contribution to downstream implementation opportunities and successful client mobilization.

**Basic Qualifications:**  

* 3+ years of professional experience in consulting, professional services, strategy, transformation, AI, data, analytics, or related client-facing roles.
* 1+ years of experience shaping or delivering AI, data science, machine learning, GenAI, agentic AI, analytics, or digital transformation initiatives. Experience may be demonstrated through client delivery, on-the-job AI work, a data science background, or an advanced degree.
* Demonstrated strategy acumen, including business model analysis, operating model design, value case development, transformation planning, and executive narrative development.
* Experience supporting presales activities such as opportunity identification, solution shaping, proposal development, business case creation, or executive-level deal reviews.
* Working knowledge of enterprise AI concepts, including LLMs, AI agents, RAG, ML lifecycle, data readiness, responsible AI, governance, and adoption considerations.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* Master's degree, MBA, data science degree, AI/ML certification, or equivalent practical AI experience.
* Experience in one or more industries such as financial services, insurance, manufacturing, healthcare and life sciences, public sector, automotive, or commercial sectors.
* Familiarity with cloud and AI platforms such as Azure, AWS, GCP, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Google/Gemini, Databricks, or Snowflake.
* Strong executive communication, structured problem solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and collaborative teaming skills.
* Ability to travel as required for client and internal engagements.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.
  
  
NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. description:
Role - Senior Director || Location - Bangalore
  
The opportunity
  
  
This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of AI, product, technology and business. You will define the organisation-wide AI product strategy and build the portfolio that moves AI from isolated use cases to repeatable, trusted and commercially meaningful outcomes.The portfolio may span generative AI, predictive machine learning, intelligent automation and AI-enabled experiences across areas such as fraud detection, risk management, customer support, personalised payment experiences and operational efficiency.
  
  
**What you will own:**  
Set the AI product vision, strategy and roadmap in close partnership with business and technology leadership.
  
Build and prioritise an AI product portfolio based on customer pain points, business value, feasibility, risk and speed to impact.
  
Lead the full product lifecycle — problem discovery, use-case definition, experimentation, prioritisation, build, launch, adoption and optimisation.
  
Partner with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, designers, platform teams and business leaders to ship reliable AI products at scale.
  
Evaluate and integrate external AI and LLM platforms where they create a clear advantage, while maintaining security, privacy, cost and performance discipline.
  
Shape modern AI product practices, including model evaluation, human-in-the-loop design, feedback loops, observability and continuous improvement.
  
**Translate AI capability into measurable business outcomes:** revenue and monetisation, cost optimisation, productivity, risk reduction, customer experience and engagement.
  
Establish practical governance for responsible AI, including regulatory compliance, data privacy, security, explainability, risk management and auditability.
  
Build the AI product management capability through talent, operating rhythms, decision frameworks, documentation and best practices.
  
Lead, mentor and grow a high-performing team while influencing senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  
  
**What success looks like:**  
A focused AI roadmap connected to priority business and customer outcomes — not a collection of disconnected experiments. \
  
AI products launched and adopted at scale, with clear measurement of value, quality, safety, reliability and user experience.
  
Visible impact through improved efficiency, productivity, customer experience, risk management, revenue or cost outcomes.
  
A strong evaluation and governance framework that enables responsible experimentation and confident deployment.
  
A repeatable AI product operating model and a growing team capable of taking ideas from insight to impact.
  
  
**What we are looking for:**  
12–14 years of product management experience, including at least 3 years building or scaling AI products.
  
A proven record of shipping B2C or B2B AI/ML-driven products at scale and taking them beyond pilots into sustained adoption.
  
Strong working knowledge of generative AI and its product applications, including LLMs, transformers, embeddings and modern AI application patterns.
  
The ability to connect technical possibilities to customer needs, commercial value and execution priorities.
  
Experience leading high-performing product teams and working effectively across product, engineering, data science, design, risk, compliance and business functions.
  
Strong strategic thinking, analytical judgement, communication and stakeholder-influence skills.
  
Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous and highly regulated environment.
  
  
**It is a strong plus if you bring:**  
Experience in payments, fintech, financial services or other regulated technology businesses.
  
Experience with AI platforms, LLM providers, model evaluation, LLMOps/MLOps, retrieval-augmented generation or AI-agent experiences.
  
A track record of balancing innovation with privacy, security, responsible AI and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Why this role:**  
Shape an organisation-wide AI agenda with direct visibility into business and customer impact.
  
Work on real, high-value use cases where AI can improve trust, speed, experience and efficiency.
  
Build the team, operating model and product discipline for the next phase of AI-led growth.

The role will work closely with Supply Chain leaders, business stakeholders, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and other cross-functional teams within the Data & AI Center of Excellence to translate business needs into scalable, data-driven solutions.

The position will have a strong focus on **Operations Research and Optimization**, including inventory optimization, allocation, scheduling, resource optimization, and integrated planning, while also leveraging Machine Learning, forecasting, and AI techniques where appropriate.

This position is part of the **Data Science Team**, **Center of Excellence in Bangalore**.

* Partner with Supply Chain leaders and business stakeholders to identify high-value opportunities, translate business needs into analytical solutions, and communicate clear recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Design and implement scalable Operations Research and optimization solutions for inventory, allocation, scheduling, resource planning, and network optimization.
* Develop Machine Learning, forecasting, and AI solutions that improve business decision-making and operational performance. Explore and develop hybrid Generative AI and Operations Research solutions that enable business users to formulate optimization problems, interact with numerical models through natural language, perform what-if scenario analysis, and understand optimization recommendations.

* Collaborate with Data Engineers and ML Engineers to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions, while providing technical guidance and mentoring junior Data Scientists.

* Emerging AI techniques, including unsupervised learning, Natural Language Processing, and Generative AI and experience combining them with mathematical optimization, including natural-language interfaces, optimization model generation, solver tool-calling, scenario analysis, explanation of solver results, and retrieval-augmented generation over business rules or technical documentation.

* MLOps and production deployment, including model monitoring, containerization, data lineage, cloud environments, visualization, and integration with enterprise Supply Chain, ERP, manufacturing, or planning systems.

description:

I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.

**Job Description**
-------------------

***Objective / Purpose:***

* Serve as a Director-level clinical data science leader and people manager within Data & Quantitative Sciences, accountable for advancing clinical data science strategy, delivery excellence, submission readiness, and team capability across assigned studies, assets, or specialty areas.
* Lead and develop a team of clinical data scientists and/or matrixed delivery contributors, setting clear priorities, enabling high-quality execution, and fostering a culture of scientific rigor, accountability, inclusion, collaboration, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.
* Translate complex clinical, biomarker, real-world, external, and high-dimensional data into actionable evidence that informs clinical development strategy, health authority interactions, regulatory submissions, governance decisions, and patient-focused decision making.
* Shape fit-for-purpose statistical, data science, and advanced analytics approaches across a portfolio, including exploratory analysis, predictive modeling, simulation, integrated data review, automation, and AI/ML-enabled methods suitable for regulated clinical development and submission use.
* Partner cross-functionally with Clinical, Clinical Pharmacology, PSPV, Clinical Data Management, Translational Sciences, Regulatory, Clinical Operations, Statistical Programming, technology/platform teams, and external partners to ensure high-quality, traceable, analysis-ready, health-authority-ready data and decision-ready insights across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.

***Accountabilities:***

* Lead design and interpretation of quantitative analyses using clinical trial data, biomarkers, real-world data, external data, and other relevant sources to generate evidence for study teams, asset teams, governance forums, health authority engagements, and regulatory submission packages.
* Guide application of statistical, machine learning, simulation, and visualization methods to support patient-level prediction, endpoint interpretation, risk assessment, scenario planning, integrated data review, evidence generation, and submission-oriented interpretation.
* Set clinical data science direction and delivery priorities for assigned studies, assets, portfolio areas, or capability domains, ensuring alignment with development objectives, functional strategy, global regulatory strategy, submission timelines, quality expectations, and stakeholder needs.
* Provide scientific, technical, operational, and submission-readiness oversight of internal teams and external delivery partners, including review of analysis plans, specifications, code, outputs, data visualization, narratives, documentation, and interpretation of findings.
* Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks related to data quality, analytic assumptions, vendor delivery, resource capacity, timelines, reproducibility, inspection readiness, and regulatory acceptability of data science outputs across multiple health authorities.
* Oversee resource planning and delivery execution across assigned work, balancing portfolio priorities, capacity, external partner contributions, submission milestones, and risk mitigation to ensure high-quality and timely outputs.
* Partner with Clinical Pharmacology, PSPV, Translational Sciences, Clinical Data Management, Regulatory, Statistical Programming, and platform teams to ensure CDISC, submission, and downstream quantitative decision-making needs are reflected in study setup, data review, analysis planning, reporting, and health authority response processes.
* Define expectations for model-ready datasets and analytics-ready data flows, including variable derivations, data quality expectations, lineage, traceability, metadata, documentation, and fit-for-purpose use in regulated clinical development, inspections, and submissions.
* Support preparation for regulatory interactions and submissions by ensuring analytical outputs are well documented, traceable, reproducible, appropriately governed, and aligned with expectations from FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, MHRA, and other relevant health authorities, as applicable.
* Provide people leadership for direct reports, including goal setting, performance management input, coaching, career development, workload prioritization, engagement, and support for talent growth and retention.
* Build team capability by mentoring and developing clinical data scientists, creating opportunities for technical growth, strengthening reproducible analytics practices, and promoting effective communication of quantitative insights in study, governance, and regulatory contexts.
* Represent Clinical Data Science in cross-functional and regulatory-facing forums, influencing stakeholders and ensuring quantitative insights are clearly connected to clinical development questions, submission strategy, health authority expectations, decisions, and patient impact.
* Drive continuous improvement in clinical data science practices through reusable code, standards, training, automation, AI-enabled workflow improvements, governed data standards, and adoption of industry best practices for submission-ready delivery.

**Education / Experience**

* PhD in statistics, biostatistics, data science, epidemiology, biomedical engineering, computer science, quantitative sciences, or related field with 8+ years of relevant experience; or MS with 12+ years of relevant experience.
* Extensive experience in clinical development within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare research environment, with demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional decisions at study, asset, portfolio, or functional level.
* Demonstrated experience contributing to regulatory submissions, health authority interactions, inspection readiness, and submission-oriented analysis, documentation, traceability, and response activities across multiple regulatory agencies or global health authorities.
* Demonstrated experience as a people manager or formal team leader, including coaching, performance input, talent development, workload prioritization, and support for employee engagement and growth.
* Experience providing technical leadership, matrix leadership, vendor oversight, and mentorship across cross-functional, geographically distributed, or externally supported delivery models.
* Track record of advancing analytical strategy, standards, automation, AI/ML-enabled approaches, or modern data science practices in a regulated clinical development and submission environment.

**Highest-priority Technical Skills**

* Expert knowledge of clinical trial design, drug development, endpoints, estimands, biomarkers, data interpretation, and the role of analytics in clinical decision making, regulatory strategy, and submission support.
* Strong foundation in statistics and quantitative methods, including longitudinal analysis, survival methods, causal reasoning, simulation, predictive modeling, and uncertainty communication for scientific, governance, and health authority audiences.
* Experience integrating and interpreting diverse data sources, including clinical trial, biomarker, real-world, external, imaging, digital health, or other high-dimensional data as appropriate to the portfolio and regulatory context.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and advanced analytics in regulated clinical development, including model development, validation, documentation, bias/assumption assessment, governance, explainability, and fit-for-purpose deployment in regulatory-relevant settings.
* Hands-on fluency in R and/or Python, with working knowledge of SAS and SQL; ability to guide reproducible analyses, code quality, version control, reusable workflows, validated delivery practices, and inspection-ready documentation.
* Strong working knowledge of CDISC standards and submission expectations, including SDTM, ADaM, controlled terminology, Define-XML concepts, reviewer guides, traceability, data lineage, and submission-oriented data package requirements.
* Deep knowledge of FDA, EMA, PMDA, NMPA, MHRA, ICH-GCP, GxP, data privacy, inspection readiness, and traceability expectations relevant to clinical data, quantitative deliverables, and global submission packages.
* Ability to establish analytical standards, technical expectations, documentation practices, quality review approaches, and submission-readiness controls that enable scalable and inspection-ready delivery across multiple health authorities.

**People Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**

* Communicates complex quantitative findings clearly to scientific, operational, technical, executive, senior leadership, and health authority-facing audiences.
* Influences across functions without relying solely on direct authority; builds trusted partnerships with clinical, statistical, programming, data management, regulatory, technology, and vendor stakeholders.
* Balances scientific rigor, speed, quality, resource capacity, regulatory risk, submission timelines, and pragmatic delivery; proactively escalates risks with options and recommendations.
* Demonstrates curiosity, continuous improvement, sound judgment, and commitment to advancing modern clinical data science capabilities, developing others, and maintaining submission-ready standards.
* Leads with clarity, accountability, inclusion, and enterprise mindset; creates an environment where team members can deliver, grow, collaborate effectively, and uphold regulatory-quality expectations.
* Coaches and develops direct reports and matrixed contributors, providing actionable feedback, supporting career growth, and building future technical, regulatory, submission, and leadership capability.

description:

At Capital One data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

Today, we are a high-tech company, a scientific laboratory, and a nationally recognized brand all in one impacting over 65 million customer accounts. Still founder-led by Chairman and CEO Richard Fairbank, we dare to dream, disrupt, and deliver a better way for our customers, the financial industry and for each other.

As a Data Scientist, you will be part of a team that is leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies to unlock the big opportunities that help drive efficiency and improve customer experience. And you will do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

**Team Description**

At Capital One India, we are at the cutting edge of solving some of the fundamental business problems using advanced data methodologies, statistics, and machine learning algorithms. The Model Risk Management team acts as a critical line of defense, identifying and mitigating risks associated with the bank's most sophisticated decision-making systems. We combine statistics, software engineering, and business expertise to drive the best outcomes for the Enterprise, ensuring that every model from deposits pricing to fraud detection is robust and reliable. We understand that we cannot prepare for tomorrow by focusing only on today; therefore, we invest heavily in new skills and building better tools to govern emerging technologies like Generative AI. Our team thrives on a rigorous challenge culture to develop increasingly powerful validation techniques that ensure model integrity and regulatory compliance.

**Role Description**

General responsibilities include but are not limited to:

* Partner cross-functionally with teams throughout the enterprise including Product and Tech to deliver solutions. You will enhance your technical and analytical skills, while also working with leaders to influence business strategies.
* Collaborate with Quants, Data Scientists, Data analysts, Business analysts and risk managers to drive innovation, and shape strategic initiatives.

* Quantitative and ML/Statistically-minded: You’ve built models, validated them, and worked with them.
* Thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment: You are comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy cutting through distractions to discern priorities and create structure where none exists.

* Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in statistics, math, engineering, economics, econometrics, finance or operations research with a quantitative focus.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of experience with relational databases and SQL.
* Strong analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: AI Operating System (AIOS) Leader
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Technology@Lilly
  
At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.
  
  
Role Summary
  
The AI Operating System (AIOS) Leader owns the strategy, architecture, and delivery of Lilly's AI Operating System — a connected, four-layer ecosystem (Data, Compute, Model, and Application) built on platforms including LillyCode, LillyPod, Weights & Biases, the LLM Gateway, and BioNova. This role leads the ML Engineering and Data Engineering teams that build and operate AIOS, combining deep technical credibility with people leadership to remove friction, eliminate duplicated work, and give every data scientist and research team at Lilly a faster path from idea to impact.
  
The AIOS Leader is accountable for advancing AIOS through its roadmap phases: from the Phase 1 foundation (LillyCode, LillyPod, the LLM Gateway, and core data infrastructure), through Phase 2 ML lifecycle maturity (production experiment tracking, model registry, and marketplace expansion), to Phase 3 R&D AI at scale (multi-modal AI and shared infrastructure enabling scientific breakthroughs). The role is the central point of accountability connecting engineering, science, and enterprise architecture, ensuring AIOS and the Enterprise Stack remain complementary rather than competing investments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* AIOS Strategy & Roadmap Ownership:

Set and own the strategy, architecture, and phased roadmap for the AI Operating System — from Phase 1 Foundation through Phase 2 ML Lifecycle to Phase 3 R&D AI at Scale — ensuring each layer of the stack (Data, Compute, Model, Application) advances against committed timelines.
  

* Team Leadership & Talent Development:

Lead, mentor, and grow the ML Engineering and Data Engineering teams, including matrixed specialists embedded with science squads through the ML Engineering Chapter; build a culture of ownership, craftsmanship, and continuous learning.
  

* AIOS Platform Ownership:

Partner with Enterprise Stack leadership (Cortex, Landing Zone, CATS/Hangar) to ensure AIOS and the Enterprise Stack remain complementary, with models built in AIOS flowing into enterprise agentic workflows and business requirements flowing back.

* Science Enablement:

* Governance & Security:

* Executive Communication & Advocacy:

* Proven experience owning a multi-layer AI/ML platform (data, compute, model, and application layers) in a large, matrixed enterprise
* Demonstrated leadership of both ML Engineering and Data Engineering functions, including managing leads across multiple squads
* Deep knowledge of GPU compute infrastructure, distributed training, and high-performance storage (e.g., GPU scheduling, parallel file systems)

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.

We are looking for a hands-on Data Scientist to develop analytical and machine learning solutions used by petroleum, drilling, production, process and reliability engineers. You will work with operational and engineering data to diagnose performance, predict outcomes and support better operating decisions across upstream and downstream assets.

  

**Role Details**

**Key responsibilities include**:

**Upstream data science**

* Develop analytical solutions for well-performance surveillance, production forecasting, artificial-lift diagnostics and equipment-health monitoring.
* Analyse drilling data to identify operating states, evaluate rate-of-penetration performance and detect patterns associated with dysfunctions or non-productive time.
* Work with production rates, well tests, pressure and temperature measurements, choke settings, lift-system parameters and intervention histories.
* Distinguish measured, tested and allocated production, accounting for shut-ins, interventions and operating-strategy changes.
* Support well-log and reservoir-related modelling with geoscience and reservoir specialists where relevant.

**Downstream data science**

* Develop inferential models and soft sensors for product quality, unit yields and process performance.
* Analyse heat-exchanger fouling, rotating-equipment condition, catalyst-performance trends, and energy or utility consumption.
* Work with process historians, laboratory systems, online analyzers, crude assays, maintenance records and simulation outputs.
* Align laboratory results with sample time and process residence time, distinguishing steady operation from start-ups, shutdowns, and grade or feedstock changes.
* Support blending, process optimization and planning using predictive models and appropriately constrained analytical methods.

**Model development and technical delivery**

* Define engineering objectives, prediction horizons, target variables, operating boundaries and acceptance criteria with domain specialists.
* Assess data quality, sampling bias, confounding, missing measurements, lineage and suitability; perform exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing and uncertainty estimation.
* Engineer domain-informed features and develop statistical, machine learning and time-series models for regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, anomaly and change-point detection.
* Establish defensible baselines and time-aware or grouped validation, preventing leakage and addressing autocorrelation, non-stationarity, imbalance, sparse labels and changing conditions.
* Evaluate using application-relevant measures, apply explainability and uncertainty methods, and use deep learning only where justified against simpler alternatives.
* Build reproducible training and inference pipelines; track experiments and monitor data quality, drift, predictive performance and training-serving consistency.
* Document assumptions, applicability limits, validation and retraining triggers; review code and guide other data scientists.

**Expected technical stack**

* Strong hands-on Python and SQL.
* Practical experience with pandas, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, statistical modelling libraries and at least one gradient-boosting framework.
* Experience with version control, automated testing, experiment tracking, model registries, deployment workflows and model monitoring.
* Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow where deep learning is appropriate.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in petroleum, chemical, mechanical or another relevant engineering discipline, statistics, mathematics, computer science or data science.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery of Oil & Gas analytical solutions, with strong experience in at least one upstream or downstream domain and working understanding of the other.
* Strong foundations in statistics, regression, classification, time-series analysis, feature engineering, model evaluation and uncertainty estimation.
* Experience with irregular sampling, missing measurements, limited failure labels, changing operating conditions and multiple operational regimes.
* Evidence of personal contribution across data assessment, development, deployment and operational monitoring.
* Experience leading or reviewing data scientists’ technical work and collaborating with engineering and technology teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience delivering analytical solutions across both upstream and downstream environments.
* Specialist depth in signal processing, reliability modelling, constrained optimization, subsurface analytics, or hybrid engineering and ML methods.
* Familiarity with well-data formats, industrial historians, laboratory systems and engineering simulators.
* Experience with cloud ML platforms or edge inference.
* Experience applying NLP, retrieval-augmented generation or agentic workflows to engineering information and analytical tools.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**

A Data Scientist who can walk through a real industrial modelling problem and clearly explain the data, engineering assumptions, baseline, feature design, validation, deployment behaviour, business relevance and model limitations, while evidencing personal technical contribution and ability to lead others.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. **EY GDS | PRINCIPAL DATA SCIENTIST**

**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**

**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**

**Experience Level 15+ Years**

  

**Job Description**

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.

We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.

  

**Role Details**

**Key responsibilities include**:

**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**

A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Intern - Data Scientist**
===========================

**Location:** Bangalore, India

**About nference**
------------------

nference is an AI-powered technology company transforming biomedical research by leveraging large-scale data, advanced machine learning, and deep scientific expertise. Our mission is to accelerate breakthroughs in healthcare and life sciences by building innovative products that help researchers and clinicians solve complex real-world problems.

**Our People**
--------------

At nference, you'll work alongside software engineers, AI researchers, physicians, scientists, and product leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful, real-world problems.

We foster a culture of ownership, curiosity, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous learning. Our teams are encouraged to ask questions, share ideas, learn from experienced colleagues, and contribute to impactful projects.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

We're looking for a motivated **Data Scientist Intern** with a strong foundation in Python, statistics, and data analysis. This internship offers an opportunity to work with complex healthcare data, develop data processing workflows, and explore practical applications of machine learning and large language models (LLMs).

You will collaborate with experienced data scientists and engineers to prepare and analyze electronic health record (EHR) data, build data pipelines, validate data quality, and support LLM-assisted information extraction and cohort refinement. This role is suited for someone who enjoys solving data-intensive problems, working with messy real-world datasets, and applying statistical reasoning to derive reliable insights.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Develop data pipelines to fetch, aggregate, clean, and preprocess raw patient data from electronic health records (EHRs).
* Apply statistical methods to understand data distributions, normalize variables, handle variations, detect anomalies, and assess data quality and integrity.
* Define, segment, and statistically validate data cohorts for analysis and research.
* Build basic batch-processing pipelines and automate data transformation workflows.
* Support LLM-assisted workflows using prompting, structured outputs, embeddings, and retrieval techniques for information extraction and cohort refinement.
* Conduct experiments, analyze results, and evaluate data and inference pipeline performance.
* Debug and optimize data processing and inference workflows.
* Use Git for version control and maintain reproducible data workflows.
* Document data cleaning rules, cohort definitions, analytical methods, and results to support reproducibility.
* Follow data privacy, security, and compliance requirements when handling healthcare data.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* Pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field**.
* Strong programming skills in **Python**, with practical knowledge of Pandas and NumPy for data manipulation and analysis.
* Solid understanding of statistical fundamentals, including data distributions, normalization, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to define, segment, and validate data cohorts using appropriate statistical methods.
* Understanding of machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) fundamentals.
* Familiarity with scikit-learn, SQL for data retrieval, and Git.
* Ability to work with messy, inconsistent, and unstructured datasets with strong attention to detail.
* Good problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Willingness to learn new tools and apply analytical techniques to real-world healthcare problems.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Academic or personal projects involving data engineering, statistical data analysis, or cohort building.
* Exposure to LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, or vector databases.
* Familiarity with LLM prompting and structured outputs for data extraction or analysis.

**What You'll Gain**
--------------------

* **Hands-on Experience:** Work with real-world healthcare data and practical data science workflows.
* **Technical Learning:** Gain exposure to machine learning, statistical analysis, data pipelines, and LLM applications.
* **Mentorship:** Learn from experienced data scientists and engineers.
* **Meaningful Impact:** Contribute to AI-powered solutions that support biomedical research and healthcare innovation.
* **Career Development:** Strengthen your analytical and technical skills in a collaborative, research-driven environment.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

nference is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds who are passionate about learning, innovation, and building technology that transforms healthcare.

title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
Why RapidClaims

US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it.

RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do.

Why this role exists

In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product.

Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together.

The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency.

What you will own

● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the

person who knows where every client stands today.

● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them.

● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found.

● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat.

● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned.

Your first 45 days

● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why.

● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week.

● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case.

How we will measure success

● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume.

● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck.

● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause.

● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform.

● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built.

What you bring

● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can

walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke.

● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure.

● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing.

● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth.

● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining.

● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it.

Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools.

What this role is not

● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome.

● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job.

● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in AI
* How many years of experience in AI deployment
* Have you worked in Health care Industry
* How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed
* what is your team leading size
* Do you have managerial experience
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period
* Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before?

Work Location: In person

Perform deep exploratory analysis on large scale customer data, identify shopping & interaction patterns, discover price elasticity & price sensitivity behaviors and build lifecycle models for targeting customers towards loyalty.

Collaborate actively with topic owners to understand and develop advanced analytics / data science

Strong engineering mindset and exposure to software engineering principles, Agile methodologies, distributed systems and applied Machine Learning.

title: Data Scientist I / Data Scientist II
description:
### **About Prismforce**

Prismforce is a Vertical SaaS company revolutionizing the Talent Supply Chain for global Technology, R&D/Engineering, and IT Services companies. Our AI-powered product suite enhances business performance by enabling operational flexibility, accelerating decision-making, and boosting profitability. Our mission is to become the leading industry cloud/SaaS platform for tech services and talent organizations worldwide.

Data Scientist I / II | Prismforce | Bangalore (Hybrid)

About Prismforce and the AI & ML team

Prismforce is a Sequoia-backed vertical SaaS company building the Talent Supply Chain platform for global technology, engineering and IT services firms, with clients across IT services, banking, healthcare and automotive.

The AI & ML team builds the intelligence layer underneath every product.That layer powers SkillPrism, SelectPrism and IntelliPrism, and our AI-readiness assessments for enterprise workforces. You will work on models that run in production for some of the largest employers in India and the US.

**What you’ll do**

1. Fine-tune transformers and LLMs (LoRA/QLoRA) for entity extraction, classification and reranking.

2. Extract entities from job descriptions and resumes, building prediction models, create knowledge graph and traversal models.

3. Build retrieval, clustering and learning-to-rank pipelines over large taxonomies.

4. Design evaluations, dig into errors, and ship models to production.

**Requirements**

1. Hands-on applied NLP or ML experience: 1–3 years for Data Scientist I, 3–5 years for Data Scientist II.

2. Strong Python, with PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, sentence-transformers, pandas and scikit-learn.

3. Has fine-tuned transformer models on their own data, such as an encoder for NER or classification, or a decoder LLM with PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA).

4. Solid grasp of embeddings, attention, contrastive training, and retrieval with bi-encoders and cross-encoders.

5. Working knowledge of classical ML: gradient boosting, logistic regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.

6. Comfort with statistics and evaluation design: sampling, significance, calibration and metric choice.

7. SQL, plus the ability to explore data at the scale of millions of records.

8. Clear written communication of experiments and results.

9. Experience with learning-to-rank, knowledge graphs or large taxonomies in a real product.

10. Experience with ML lifecycle tooling: experiment tracking, model versioning, Docker, and GPU training and serving on AWS.

**Nice to have**

* Graph databases and graph ML: Neo4j and Cypher, pgvector, node embeddings, link prediction.

We are seeking a highly skilled and visionary **Data Scientist, Fraud,** to design and scale advanced data science solutions that protect Navan's customers, platform, and financial ecosystem.

This is a strategic and hands-on role, where you'll partner with other fraud strategy members, product, engineering, and data teams to design the ML features, build the rule workflow, build next-generation fraud models, develop actionable insights, and lead the application of AI/ML to mitigate emerging fraud threats both in expense card issuing and travel fraud. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in machine learning and data systems with a strong understanding of payment, identity, and transactional fraud patterns.

**Location:** Bangalore, India

#### **What You'll Do**

* Lead the design and deployment of advanced ML features, build rule workflows to detect and prevent fraud across travel and expense.
* Lead the design and development of advanced ML and statistical models to detect, predict, and prevent fraudulent behavior across onboarding, payments, and expense workflows.
* Drive applied research in anomaly detection, network/graph modelling, real-time clustering, and link analysis to identify emerging fraud patterns and organized fraud rings.
* Partner cross-functionally with other Risk Strategy team members, Fraud operations, Engineering, and Product teams to translate insights into scalable prevention rules, thresholds, and model-driven interventions.

* Mentor junior data scientists and fraud analysts, providing technical guidance and driving excellence in experimentation, model governance, and reproducibility.
* Contribute to the overall fraud strategy roadmap, helping evolve Navan's machine learning and analytics capabilities to stay ahead of emerging fraud trends.
* Partner with external vendors and third-party data sources to enrich detection signals and improve model precision and recall.

#### **What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years of experience in data science strategy, with a strong focus on fraud detection, risk modeling, or financial crime analytics.
* Master's (must-have) or PhD (preferred) in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative field.
* Deep technical expertise in machine learning, predictive modelling, anomaly detection, and network analysis applied to fraud problems.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

description:

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
